name: attn
description: attn — an omgbase-native prototype of a hyper-low-friction attention app: intents and cues are Markdown documents, the focus is a pointer document, the Stream an append-only daily log, `#focus` a virtual OQX join; every switch one atomic `apply` under CAS, over the MINIMAL tools profile (Lit 3 + signals, MCP over Streamable HTTP through webdevproxy)
